# Feature: generic unknown mode

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #34 -->

## Intent
An unknown or empty repo is Generic Process/Static Mode (unsupported), not a fake Web/Three.js detect. A manual launch command is stored as an override, not as auto-detect evidence. Confirm is required before a process starts.

## Preconditions
- Read-only discovery (#12)
- Adapter SDK (#32)
- `potato init --confirm` and argv `commands.start` (#13)
- Setup detect UI override field (#22)

## Happy Path
- [x] Unknown repo produces a Generic/unsupported candidate, not a Web false-positive
- [x] Manual launch command is stored as override, not as auto-detect evidence
- [x] Confirm remains required before a process starts
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [x] `package.json` without web markers is not Three.js/Web
- [x] Empty start argv is static mode (no process)
- [x] Start argv is an array, never a shell string

## Regression
- [x] Web-threejs fixture still detects web/vite/threejs
- [x] `potato init` without `--confirm` still writes nothing
- [x] Dashboard token stays out of localStorage
- [x] Out: Unity adapter

## Assumptions
- UI copy is English
- Kind stays `unknown` (generic/unsupported presentation)
- Dashboard may depend only on the local API JSON, not `@potato-boost/schemas`

## Security Coverage
- B-04 / Potato-Boost: argv arrays; `shell: false` on spawn
- P-04: config writes stay inside project root
- F-03: no tokens in localStorage
- Out of scope: F-01, B-01, auth store

## Implementation Notes
- Web detector requires `index.html` only; `package.json` alone is `unknown`.
- `commands.startSource` is `inferred` | `override` (Zod default `inferred`).
- `resolveRunStart` uses override argv from `potato.config.yaml`; generic kinds otherwise stay static (`[]`).
- Doctor: generic repos mark browser/start as `unsupported` and not required.
- CLI: `init --start` is an override; `run`/`ci`/`doctor` read resolved start; no spawn without override.
- Dashboard: unknown is labeled Generic (unsupported) and auto-selected when it is the only candidate.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: detect unknown → optional start override → confirm writes config → run may spawn only that argv.
- N-actors: one repo → at most one process (or static `[]`).
- Invalid: package.json-only stays `unknown`; inferred start on generic is ignored.
- Two consumers: doctor and run both use `resolveRunStart`.
